title: 生命と倫理
subtitle: Bioethics
keywords: Reproduction 2.Regenerative medicine 3.Genetic manipulation 4.Death and Euthanasia 5.Quality of life (QOL)
educationalGoal: As a result of the remarkable progress made in science and technology, we now face bioethics issues such as genetic manipulation and reproduction. Students will learn what is being asked about these issues.
advice: We will cover the following topics: 1. Bioethics: Life and QOL 2. Genetic manipulation: Genetic recombination and gene therapy 3. Organ transplantation: Brain death and cloning technology 4. Reproduction: Fertilization and prenatal diagnosis
requiredKnowledge: Read the textbook before class Check any unknown terminology

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the basic idea of bioethics.
Ability to explain the outline of genetic manipulation, and give an opinion about it.
Ability to discuss the problem of bioethics with respect to medical treatment.
Ability to form an opinion about reproduction.
